items.title: A morphism pseudo-coherent over a pseudo-coherent base is pseudo-coherent
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: If f : X -> Y is pseudo-coherent over a base scheme S (i.e. the structure map X -> S is pseudo-coherent while Y -> S also is), then f itself is pseudo-coherent. The retained proof translates to composable ring maps R -> A -> B with R -> A and R -> B pseudo-coherent and concludes via More on Algebra, composition-relative-pseudo-coherent. The author's displayed algebra conclusion sentence re-uses 'R -> B' where the intended content is the map A -> B (visible in-source slip kept verbatim per lane policy; no recalculation done for the author). Retained author proof at lines 17445-17452.
